title: Load dashboard statistics after login
description: An authenticated admin can open the dashboard and see key statistics loaded successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/dashboard
Verify key dashboard statistics are displayed
Verify dashboard navigation controls are displayed

title: Navigate from dashboard to an admin section and back
description: An authenticated admin can move from the dashboard into an admin section and return without losing access.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/dashboard
Click the link to open an admin section
Verify the selected admin section is displayed
Click the link to return to the dashboard
Verify the dashboard is displayed again

title: Keep dashboard access after moving between admin areas
description: An authenticated admin can repeatedly leave the dashboard for admin sections and return while the session remains active.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/dashboard
Click the link to open an admin section
Click the link to return to the dashboard
Click another admin section link
Verify the dashboard navigation remains available after returning

title: Review dashboard in mobile portrait layout
description: An authenticated admin using a narrow viewport can review the dashboard stats and navigate to admin sections on mobile.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/dashboard
Verify key dashboard statistics are displayed
Verify dashboard navigation controls are displayed

title: Show an error state when dashboard data cannot be loaded
description: An authenticated admin sees an error state on the dashboard when dashboard data is not available and can retry later.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/dashboard
Verify dashboard statistics are displayed

title: Prevent unauthenticated access to the dashboard
description: An unauthenticated visitor who opens the dashboard is redirected or shown access denial instead of the protected admin view.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/dashboard
Verify access is denied or the user is redirected to authentication
Verify the admin dashboard is not displayed

title: Display a usable empty dashboard state
description: An authenticated admin sees a clear empty state when the dashboard has no statistics to show.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/dashboard
Verify an empty state is displayed
